patch:
@@ -1,22 +0,0 @@
-#!/usr/bin/env bash
-# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR
-
-ROOT=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")")
-# shellcheck source=setup
-source "$ROOT/bin/setup"
-SPYTHON="uv run spython"
-
-rm -f container.def
-{
-  echo "# This file is auto-generated by bin/generate-container-def"
-  echo "# DO NOT EDIT"
-  echo ""
-} >> container.def
-${RUN} ${SPYTHON} recipe .devcontainer/Dockerfile | \
-  grep -v SHELL | \
-  sed 's!%post!%post -c /bin/bash!g' | \
-  sed '/%runscript/,$d' | \
-  sed 's/\r$//g' \
-  >> container.def
-  # grep -V SHELL >> container.def
-chmod 444 container.def

@@ -577,7 +577,6 @@ dependencies = [
     { name = "reuse" },
     { name = "ruamel-yaml" },
     { name = "ruff" },
-    { name = "spython" },
     { name = "tqdm" },
 ]
 
@@ -591,7 +590,6 @@ requires-dist = [
     { name = "reuse", specifier = ">=6.2.0" },
     { name = "ruamel-yaml", specifier = ">=0.19.1" },
     { name = "ruff", specifier = ">=0.15.0" },
-    { name = "spython", specifier = ">=0.3.14" },
     { name = "tqdm", specifier = ">=4.67.3" },
 ]
 
@@ -710,15 +708,6 @@ wheels = [
     { url = "https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/f6/b0/2d823f6e77ebe560f4e397d078487e8d52c1516b331e3521bc75db4272ca/ruff-0.15.0-py3-none-win_arm64.whl", hash = "sha256:c480d632cc0ca3f0727acac8b7d053542d9e114a462a145d0b00e7cd658c515a", size = 10865753, upload-time = "2026-02-03T17:53:03.014Z" },
 ]
